pr_title: [ML] validate remote cluster version when datafeed contains runtime_mappings
pr_body:
Recently `runtime_mappings` were added to the datafeed config.

Since datafeeds support cross-cluster-search, we should validate the remote cluster connection versions.

We only need to do this when runtime_mappings are defined in the datafeed config.

Previously, the search would just fail when running against the remote cluster and write an error audit message.

close https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/69187
pr_comments:
Note: For datafeeds, the only place we call for field caps is in the scroll extractor. And only then do we really care about the timefield. 

Since we block using runtime_mappings for the time field, we are filtering out any of the runtime_fields from the capabilities request and are NOT setting the `runtime_fields` option. 

So, the runtime mappings check should be for 7.11 and not for 7.12. Since we don't use the field caps API in conjunction with runtime_mappings (which was not introduced until 7.12)

issue_context.title: [ML] Better handle cross cluster search failures due to runtime mappings

review_comments: Just FYI: In my PR introducing remote cluster version validation, I decided to replace `TransformConfig.minRequiredClusterVersion` with `TransformConfig.getAdditionalValidations` the reason being code duplication.
